name: closed_window_total_ACH_HSCW_summer_night

name: open_window_total_ACH_HSCW_summer_night

limitations: Total ACH, not incremental ACH; do not add baseline infiltration again.

name: summer_infiltration_population_quartiles

name: original_paper_direct_solar_reduction_options
